beats.event: 1873: Sethe and Denver live in ghost-haunted 124 Bluestone
Paul D arrives from Sweet Home and dispels the haunting
The three of them go together to a carnival
A mysterious young woman named Beloved appears outside
Household takes her in; Denver believes she is her sister
Paul D uneasy; Beloved encounter unlocks buried trauma
Stamp Paid shows Paul D newspaper clippings on the killing
Sethe confesses she killed her daughter to spare her slavery
Paul D leaves, saying her love is too thick
Sethe fixates on Beloved as her returned murdered daughter
Beloved grows demanding and pregnant-like; consumes Sethe
Denver breaks isolation and asks the community for help
Women exorcise Beloved; Sethe attacks landlord with ice pick
Beloved vanishes; Denver integrates into the community
Paul D returns; tells Sethe she is her own best thing
